text: Bitcoin's 3.9% gain is outpacing Ethereum's 2.6%, and BTC dominance has expanded to 58.8%, suggesting investors are rotating toward perceived safety in the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index at 72 (Greed) reflects broad confidence, though $113B in 24h volume is moderate rather than euphoric—indicating measured risk appetite rather than FOMO-driven buying. Altcoins like SOL are keeping pace, but the stronger Bitcoin performance and rising dominance suggest the market is rewarding macro strength over alternative bets.
